summary: End-to-end testing of import flow (sitemap scan + content paste), cover generation guard rails, publisher.article_url /blog/blog/ collapse and ConnectSite domain trimming. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_import_covers.py. Frontend: Library page shows library-missing-covers-button with correct count '(3)', library-import-button opens import-dialog, scanning https://openfactura.es/sitemap.xml returns 3 import-found-i items, article rows render '· importado' tag and w-16 cover placeholder, ConnectSite correctly strips trailing /blog so 'https://openfactura.es/blog' is saved and reloads as 'https://openfactura.es' (blog_url_pattern persists as 'https://openfactura.es/blog/{slug}').
critical_code_review_comments: routes_import.py scan(): regex r'/(blog|articulos?|noticias|posts?)/[^/]+/?$' correctly picks only post-level URLs from sitemap; falls back to all URLs when no posts match. Fine.
routes_import.py do_import(): 400-char threshold for pasted content is reasonable to force useful content; needs_content short-circuit lets the UI prompt the user to paste. Good UX.

routes_articles.py start_covers(): uses asyncio.create_task without storing the task reference; if the event loop GCs it, work could be dropped. Low-risk in uvicorn but consider holding the task in COVER_JOBS[pid]['task'].

routes_articles.py create_image() for Gemini: iterates r.candidates[0].content.parts but keeps only the LAST inline_data; if the model returns text+image parts the loop still works but it should break when found and raise clearly if none. Also missing: await base64.b64decode(part.inline_data.data) is not needed because Gemini SDK already returns bytes — current code assigns bytes directly to data, good.

publisher.article_url() collapses '/blog/blog/' once; if pattern were '/blog/blog/blog/' it would still leave '/blog/blog/'. Current ConnectSite UI strips trailing /blog before saving so this is defensive. OK.

ConnectSite saveDomain regex .replace(/\/blog$/, '') strips only one trailing /blog segment — matches backend expectation. If user types 'https://x.com/blog/blog' both layers will leave '/blog' intact; low priority.

Library.jsx and ImportDialog.jsx: all required data-testid present (library-missing-covers-button, library-import-button, import-dialog, import-url-input, import-scan-button, import-found-i, import-run-button, import-paste-title-i, import-paste-content-i, import-pasted-button, import-publish-checkbox, article-cover-i).
Login button in /login does NOT have type='submit'; pressing Enter in password field won't trigger submission. Minor UX nit, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST article in TestImport project (slug test-pasted-<ts>) during pytest run. Did not delete to leave realistic data for next agent. Fake openai key was added and DELETED. blog_url_pattern on TestImport was mutated during the collapse test and restored to original value in finally{}.
